mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) compresses equity valuations through elevated discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.5% (UNRATE > 5.5%) signals an economic slowdown that triggers central bank stimulus, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, driving corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction (HOUST and RSAFS both above 3-month averages) fails to produce positive 60d returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial contraction (INDPRO declining for 3 months), reduced corporate output and earnings lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST > 2000 thousand units) signal strong residential construction, boosting related sectors and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 2000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained inflation rate above 3.5% (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) signals central bank tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction (PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling) fails to produce positive 5d returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%), a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns due to aggressive monetary tightening over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation and high interest rates
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.
